headline: PPL (PPL) And Blackstone Buy 500 Acres For Potential Data Center Power Plants
summary: PPL Corporation (NYSE:PPL) and Blackstone Infrastructure have acquired over 500 acres in Luzerne County, Pennsylvania, for potential power plant development. The sites are being evaluated as possible future electricity sources for current and prospective data centers in the region. The project is described as exploratory and has not yet reached a final development decision or timeline. PPL is a regulated utility holding company with a core focus on electricity transmission and distribution...
